entities.summary: The Prime Minister of Morocco, officially the Head of Government, is the head of government of the Kingdom of Morocco. Since the adoption of the 2011 Constitution, the head of government is appointed by the king of Morocco from the political party that wins the largest number of seats in the House of Representatives, usually the general secretary of that party.
